company.name: Eli Lilly
company.shortDescription: Eli Lilly is a pharma company focused on developing medicines for diabetes, cancer, immunology, and other major health areas.
company.description: Eli Lilly engages in the discovery, development, manufacture, and sale of products in the pharmaceutical products business segment. The company manufactures and distributes products through owned or leased facilities in the United States, Puerto Rico, and 25 other countries. Its products are sold in approximately 135 countries. It also conducts research to find products to treat diseases in animals and to increase the efficiency of animal food production.

items.description: Eli Lilly and Hanmi Pharm formed a global (ex-Korea) licensing partnership to co-develop and commercialize Hanmi’s Phase 2 GLP-2 agonist sonefpeglutide for short bowel syndrome and other indications, with Lilly gaining exclusive manufacturing and sales rights outside Korea.

sources.title: Lilly maintains deal streak with $1.2B pact for Hanmi’s GLP-2 candidate

items.description: Eli Lilly and AI biotech Profluent Bio signed a multi-year research collaboration under which Profluent will use its AI models to design site-specific recombinases for multiple genomic targets, while Lilly gains exclusive licensing rights to selected DNA-editing assets and will advance them into development and commercialization. The deal includes an upfront payment, R&D funding, up to $2.25 billion in milestones, and royalties for Profluent.

sources.title: Lilly, AI biotech Profluent ink $2.25B pact in search of genetic medicine ‘holy grail’
